text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I caught sight of Almond Eye in 
the cafeteria.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
choice_data_list: You're in an awfully good mood.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's right. After all, today is my 
long-awaited cheat day!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I decided that on this day, I'd eat 
whatever I liked. I'm so looking forward 
to it♪
"*staaaaare...* ☆ *staaaaare...*"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, I notice several Umamusume 
watching us from Almond Eye's blind spot.
choice_data_list: (I wonder what those two are up to...)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, don't mind if I do. ...Say 
aaah—"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ah, incredible...! The strawberry aroma 
just spreads softly through my mouth...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Mmm...! This matcha is delicious too. The 
balance of bittersweet and sweet is so 
good, it tastes so... refined.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Every time I taste each flavor, I get so 
excited... It's like I'm a kid again!♪
choice_data_list:
Huh, really that much...?! Maybe I should 
buy one too.

Huh, really that much...?! Maybe I should 
buy one too.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~, look at that blissful smile. Ehehe, 
Falco's gonna order one later too♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
――Ah! Even Falco got carried away...! 
Tarumae-chan, this is――!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Even though you just said it's 
'delicious', there's a charm that speaks 
straight to the heart... This is truly a 
natural gift—...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After school that day. While conducting 
Almond Eye's training...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!
choice_data_list: Shall we take a break soon?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...No, I'm going to keep going. My time 
hasn't changed much from last time...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
If it ends right here, I'll be so 
frustrated I won't be able to sleep...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: So, just a little more! —Haaaaaaah...!

Mmm...! That competitive spirit of hers is 
seriously amazing, as expected!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that, she's so earnest—you 
can really feel she's giving it her 
absolute all...! Mmm, you just can't help 
but want to root for her~!
choice_data_list: Do you two need something from Ai...?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Excuse us. We just got completely 
entranced watching you...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: To Ai-chan's talent as an idol!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. My Umadol and locodol eyes saw 
right through it, bang!☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ai-chan is such an eye-catching Umamusume, 
isn't she? Honest, cheerful, and 
approachable, yet every little thing she 
does has this brilliant flairâ

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that, she's a model student 
in both academics and athletics, and 
super-times-nine hates losing! She's a 
bundle of talent! There's nothing about 
her you can't root for as an Umadol!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye is not acting as an idol by any 
means, yet to receive this much praise... 
In that case—
choice_data_list:
I'm performing live at a fan meeting soon, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Really? Um, please let me observe!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Later on, a huge crowd of fans attended 
Almond Eye's live performance.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all for coming today! I promise 
you, I'll make this the best live concert 
ever—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Burn the brilliance of Ai into your eyes!

text_block_list.name: Falco & Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Ngggh! Hauh...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
O-Our eyes just met...! Those straight, 
piercing eyes—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
W-What should I do... I think my heart 
won't stop racing...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—Ai! Falco is watching you super closely, 
okay~?!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Falco-san...! You're so right! Ai-chan is 
the best~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with the excitement still lingering in 
the air, Almond Eye's live performance 
came to an end...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I knew it! I thought I spotted you two in 
the audience... Thank you for watching my 
live performance.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Seriously...! I was so moved! Especially 
when you made eye contact with everyone, 
I'm beyond satisfied! ☆

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
! You noticed...! Fufu, that was actually 
the part I was most particular about.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Since this is a fan meeting, I'm going to 
give the fans an unforgettable live show." 
—That's what I'd decided.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I practiced. So that I could 
look everyone who supports me right in the 
eye."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So that's how it was...! Yeah, I'm sure it 
made a lasting impression on the fans' 
hearts too!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Thinking of her fans with such pure 
feelings. That's just who Ai-chan is, 
isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, really! Ai-chan, make sure you 
treasure it forever—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: That sheer talent as an idol!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Eh, an idol...?
choice_data_list:
You've got the makings of a wonderful 
idol.

You've got the makings of a wonderful 
idol, don't you?

It just means you're loved by the fans 
that much.

Guess I'll just have to become a 
world-class idol!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Eh, an idol...?
choice_data_list:
You've got the makings of a wonderful 
idol.

You've got the makings of a wonderful 
idol, don't you?

It just means you're loved by the fans 
that much.

Guess I'll just have to become a 
world-class idol!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Is that so, I wonder...? Still, if it's 
true, I'm quite honored.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Captivating everyone on a shining stage. 
That's not something just anyone can do! 
If it suits me, I'm honestly pretty happy♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I-I sense the birth of a legendary 
idol...! Falco can't afford to lose 
either!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so that's how it is. ...Indeed, it is 
an honor to be cheered on. I must show my 
gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
In that case, how about doing a concert 
together for the fans sometime? I'm sure 
everyone would love it!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
A joint live with Tarumae-san and the 
others...! In that case, we really need to 
fire ourselves up.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I want to show everyone a performance 
that rivals our seniors!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Hey, why did it turn out like that?!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Sure, I don't dislike concerts or events, 
but... The most important thing right now 
is racing, isn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry! As an Umadol, I can balance 
being an idol and racing just fine☆"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Plus, I think being a local idol would 
suit you too! Hey, where's your hometown, 
Ai-chan!?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Wh-What...? Am I being scouted...?!
